name: Gateway Theta · 4 Hz binaural
note: The Gateway-style state: beat in the theta band. Entrainment evidence is mixed (Ingendoh 2023: 5 of 14 EEG studies positive, 8 negative); relaxation is the reliable part. Headphones required.

name: Alpha Focus · 10 Hz binaural
note: The best-studied beat: alpha 10 Hz ≥10 min reduced acute procedural pain in several RCTs (BMC Complement Med 2024 review), though most trials carry high risk of bias.

name: Deep Theta · 6 Hz binaural
note: Theta-band meditation target. Two small chronic-pain RCTs positive, one negative — honest status: plausible, unproven.

name: Delta Sleep · 2 Hz binaural
note: Delta-band beat for sleep onset. Lab entrainment at delta has some support (Karino 2006); clinical sleep outcomes rest on thin trials. Keep volume minimal.

name: GENUS-style · 40 Hz click train
note: The actual auditory stimulus class used in MIT/Cognito gamma-entrainment Alzheimer's studies (1 hr/day; phase III trial N≈530 completed 2025, results pending). Not a cure — an experimental protocol under FDA breakthrough-status review.

name: Schumann Octave · 7.83 Hz beat
note: Dual grade: the 7.83 Hz figure is exact geophysics (Earth–ionosphere cavity, grade A arithmetic); the claim that hearing it as a beat couples your body to the planet is symbolic (grade D meaning). The report's own 7–7.5 Hz claim lives here too.

name: Pink Noise · sleep-masking bed
note: The unglamorous workhorse: masking noise improves subjective sleep (Cochrane 2022 music/sleep review; pink-noise memory studies in older adults). Note: the 2023 review found beats EMBEDDED in pink noise never entrained — keep beds quiet.
